title: Ixtenco Otomi - Wikipedia
text: Ixtenco Otomi, also known as Tlaxcala Otomi, is a native American language spoken in the town of San Juan Bautista Ixtenco in the state of Tlaxcala, Mexico. It has been classified as Eastern Otomi by Lastra (2006).

title: Otomi - Wikipedia
text: The Otomi language, belonging to the Oto-Pamean branch of the Oto-Manguean language family, is spoken in many different varieties, some of which are not mutually intelligible.
